name: Bohnanza
summary: Bean farming card game where players plant, trade, and sell bean sets to earn the most gold coins.
rules_text: Players have 2 fields (3rd can be bought for 3 coins) and a hand of bean cards whose order may never be changed. On your turn: 1) You must plant the first card in hand into a field matching its type or empty, harvesting a field if needed; you may plant a second. 2) Draw 2 cards face up. You must plant them or trade/donate them. You may trade any cards from hand but only with active player; all acquired beans must be planted immediately, harvesting if necessary. 3) Draw 3 cards one by one to the back of your hand, reshuffling discards when deck empties. Harvest value is shown on bean cards: number of beans determines coins earned. Game ends after draw pile is exhausted three times, then all fields are harvested and most coins wins, tie broken by most cards left in hand.
